scope: Offline source/evidence triage; no new runtime or terminal-emulator measurements, no regrading.

Q01.title: Observe cells, geometry and history
Q01.nextMeasurement: Use a disposable pane with independently confirmed rows/columns; compare cell contents, cursor, margins and scrollback before/after, then retain the observation and cleanup receipt. For insert/replace mode, write controlled text under SM/RM 4 and compare shifted versus overwritten cells after each transition. CPR alone cannot prove content or erasure.

Q02.title: Observe attributes and rendered pixels
Q02.nextMeasurement: Assert decoded cell attributes/charset mapping and independently capture controlled rendered pixels. Use a controlled clock for blink; preserve the input, capture hashes and restored fixture state. For OSC 104/110/111/112/117/119, save prior colors and host defaults, set known overrides, issue the exact reset, then compare palette/default/cursor/selection state and pixels against the known defaults. Query where a concrete reply exists; an unset selection default may have no concrete reply. Restore prior state and verify restoration. Cursor advance is insufficient.

Q03.title: Observe host metadata and UI effects
Q03.nextMeasurement: Read the private pane's title, cwd, hyperlink/shell-marker metadata or notification/progress presentation through an independent host observer. Record private setting/focus preconditions and verify restoration. A consumed marker or DA sentinel is insufficient.

Q04.title: Observe image pixels and playback
Q04.nextMeasurement: Capture decoded/rendered pixels and placement in a private fixture; animation requires timed frame evidence. Do not infer pixel output, placeholders or playback from query recognition or cursor movement.

Q05.title: Generate and validate input events
Q05.nextMeasurement: Inject a controlled key/keypad/mouse event in an owned pane and compare the actual encoded child-input report, including coordinates and modifiers. A mode response does not prove input encoding.

Q06.title: Observe saved/restored terminal state
Q06.nextMeasurement: Compare complete main/alternate buffer contents, saved cursor and relevant mode/attribute state before entry, while active, and after restoration. A responsive cursor after exit is insufficient.

Q07.title: Unimplemented query variant
Q07.nextMeasurement: The reviewed dispatcher has no reply for this exact query variant. Add a narrowly scoped contract and request/reply regression before implementation, or explicitly document the variant as intentionally unavailable. Rerun the owned query after any change; retain the original inconclusive grade.

Q08.title: Conditional selection-color query
Q08.nextMeasurement: OSC 17/19 are implemented, but unset derived selection colors can be null and intentionally produce no concrete reply. In a private fixture, set a known override, query it, restore it and verify restoration; test host-derived defaults separately.

Q09.title: Kitty image-number/acknowledgement gap
Q09.nextMeasurement: The probe sends uppercase I image numbers. The reviewed implementation reads lowercase i and emits replies for a=q, not correlated allocation acknowledgements for these a=t/T probes. Add image-number allocation/ack/cleanup contract tests; existing basic image decoding is separate evidence.

Q10.title: Source-reviewed limited or missing variant
Q10.nextMeasurement: The exact spelling/variant has a source limitation listed with this row. Add a focused state/effect contract and owned observer, implement separately if desired, and rerun; do not equate related supported protocols with this variant.

Q11.title: Keep clipboard ownership refusal
Q11.nextMeasurement: These OSC 52 packets were not sent. Keep them refused until the owned collector itself has a disposable clipboard and verified restoration/cleanup. Separate native CI interchange results do not retroactively qualify these observations. OSC 52 reads intentionally return denial.

Q12.title: Negative query response is not a full capability result
Q12.nextMeasurement: DECRQSS and XTGETTCAP return well-formed failure responses for the requested setting/name. Preserve that evidence; enumerate and test individual supported/unsupported settings before claiming the whole query family.

Q13.title: Collector API/legacy evidence gap
Q13.nextMeasurement: This is an adapter/API observation, not proof of missing VT behavior. Add an owned reset/state readback adapter or replace the legacy feature hint with explicit assertions. Do not invoke an unowned app reset or use a legacy hint as support evidence.
